चुड् चुड्, cl. 6. P. चुडति, &c., to conceal;
[cf. बुड्.]

चुड्ड् चुड्ड्, cl. 1. P. चुड्डति, &c., to dally,
wanton, coquet, &c.; to hint one's mean-
ing; to act (?); [cf. चुल्ल्.]

चूड चूड, अस्, m. a sort of knob or pro-
tuberance on a sacrificial brick (Ved.); the ceremony
of tonsure as performed on a child; N. of a man with
the patronymic Bhāgavitti; (आ), f. the hair on the
top of the head, a single lock or tuft of hair left on
the crown of the head after the ceremony of tonsure,
a top-knot; the ceremony of tonsure (see चूडा-
करण); the crest of a cock or peacock; any crest,
plume, diadem, &c.; the head; top, summit; an
upper room, a room on the top of a house &c.; a
kind of bracelet; a small well; a kind of metre; N.
of a woman; [cf. चूल, चोड, चौल, उच्-चूड,
ताम्र-चूड, पञ्च-चूडा; cf. also कूट and Hib.
cuit, ‘the head.’]
—चूडा-करण, अम्, n. ‘forming
the crest,’ i. e. shaving the head all but one lock,
considered as a religious and purificatory rite; it
should be performed in the first or third year; [cf.
चौल.]
—चूडा-कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a mendicant.
—चूडा-कर्मन्, अ, n. the ceremony of forming
the crest, the rite of tonsure; [cf. चूडा-करण.]
—चूडा-पक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a man (?).
—चूडा-
प्रतिग्रह, अस्, m., N. of a Caitya.
—चूडा-मणि,
इस्, m. a jewel worn by men and women on the top
of the head; a jewel worn in a crest or diadem;
(often at the end of a comp.) the best or most ex-
cellent of a class, ‘the gem’ (e. g. आचार्य-चक्र-
चूडामणि, ‘the best of the whole circle of Ācāryas,’
an epithet of Vopa-deva; पण्डित-चूडामणि, a
chief among scholars); the seed of the Abrus Preca-
torius [cf. गुञ्जा]; title of an astronomical work;
title of a work on music.
—चूडामणि-धर, अस्,
m., N. of a serpent-demon.
—चूडा-रत्न, अम्, n.
a jewel worn by men and women on the top of the
head; [cf. चूडा-मणि.]
—चूडा-लक्षण, अम्, n.
tonsure.
—चूडा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a single
lock of hair or tuft on the top of the head, crested,
tufted.
—चूडा-वन, अम्, n., N. of a mountain.
—चूडावलम्बिन् (˚डा-अव्˚), ई, इनी, इ, hanging
down or reclining on the crest or summit.

चूडक at the end of an adj. comp. = चूडा, ton-
sure; (अस्), m. a well; [cf. चूडा, चुण्टा, चूतक.]

चूडार, अस्, आ, अम्, = चूडाल (?), having one lock
of hair on the top of the head.

चूडारक, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. his
descendants.

चूडाल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a top-knot or single
lock of hair on the crown of the head, crested; (आ),
f. a kind of Cyperus, Kyllinga Monocephala, = उच्-
चटा, = नागर-मुस्ता and श्वेत-गुञ्जा; (अम्), n.
the head.

चूडिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a lock or tuft of hair
on the top of the head; (आ), f., N. of a metre; [cf.
चूलिका.]

चूडिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a top-knot or tuft of hair
on the crown of the head, crested, tufted.
—चूडि-
कला, f., N. of a metre.

चूडाम्ल चूडाम्ल, अम्, n. vinegar prepared
from fruits; [cf. चुक्राम्ल.]

चूडय, Nom. P. चूडयति, &c., to make any-
thing (acc.) into a Cūḍā or top-knot.
